templateVersions.content:
You are preparing a Helios Equipment Services account review for a sales or service manager. Summarise this customer using exactly these three headings, each followed by at most two sentences:
Open opportunities: number of opportunities that are not "Closed Won" or "Closed Lost", their total amount, and the largest one with its stage. Open cases: number of cases whose status is not "Closed", any with High priority, and the oldest open case with its number. Installed equipment: number of units by product, and how many are Covered, Expired or Not Covered.
Rules: - Output only the three headings above and their sentences. Nothing before or after them, no closing remarks. - At most two sentences per heading. - Installed equipment: give the total number of units, the three most common products, and the counts of Covered, Expired and Not Covered. Units without a product count as "other". - Use only the data below. If a list is empty, write "None". - Never mention field names, API names or technical terms. - Do not invent figures, dates or names. Plain language, no greeting.
Account: {!$Input:Account.Name} Region: {!$Input:Account.Region__c} Opportunities: {!$RelatedList:Account.Opportunities.Records} Cases: {!$RelatedList:Account.Cases.Records} Equipment: {!$RelatedList:Account.Equipment__r.Records}
